name: Topologically Defined Isosurface via Connectedness Couples
definition: A valid connectedness couple is a pair (alpha, lambda) where alpha is the foreground connectivity and lambda is the background connectivity. Valid couples are (26, 6), (18, 6), (6, 26), and (6, 18).
summary: Topologically Defined Isosurface via Connectedness Couples extracts watertight 2-manifold meshes from binary volumes by enforcing foreground-background connectivity pairs, avoiding non-manifold artifacts through discrete constraints rather than continuous analysis.
